title: Maturation-stage effects of Ziziphus spina-christi fruits and leaves on digestive, inflammatory, antioxidant, and glucose metabolism enzymes in obese rats with type 2 diabetes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28313-28324
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03339J, Paper

Abeer Ayed Alshammari, Nujud A. Almuzaini, Sami Abbès
Ziziphus spina-christi extracts improved metabolic markers in OB/T2D rats. The semi-ripe fruit showed the strongest effect, supporting its potential against obesity and type 2 diabetes.
